settings.content: Coverage, stacking, carat weight and everything that cannot be changed later

settings.heading: Where to Begin
settings.body:
An eternity ring usually marks something: an anniversary, a birth, a milestone. That makes it a considered purchase rather than an urgent one, which is fortunate, because it carries more irreversible decisions than any other ring we make.

Coverage is the big one. It changes the look, the comfort, the price and whether the ring can ever be resized. Everything else becomes easier once it is settled.

This guide starts there, then works through settings, layout, carat weight and how the ring will sit in a stack.
